_doctrine: R-025: the tutorial arc. NOC-for-Godot-3D across all 22 spine chapters. Each chapter's beats are authored to BUILD ON the vocabulary of prior chapters (builds_on names them). roles = the beat skeleton; casting (role -> real artifact) happens per-sequence against the map inventory. Voltage (the critical script) is chosen per chapter from its charged artifacts.

chapters.teaches: the vocabulary of space itself — point, line, plane, solid, coordinate frame
move a thing without changing what it IS — translate, rotate, scale; dot/cross products; matrices compose motion; the invariant under motion
roles: the dot product — projection, how aligned
prove it — match a target pose

chapters.teaches: the grid as an addressable structure — index to position, repetition as a first-class move
roles: one cell, addressed — index to position
mirror and symmetry on the grid
prove it — reproduce a target pattern

chapters.teaches: color as a system — hue, value, saturation — and how color becomes composition
roles: the artists' systems — Albers, Mondrian, Rothko
prove it — match a target composition

chapters.teaches: the calculus substrate — derivative as instantaneous rate, integral as accumulation, vector field as flow; the vocabulary forces/waves/randomness/noise all use
roles: the slope at a point — the tangent
the derivative pair — function and its rate
velocity as the derivative of position
the vector field — flow at every point
partial derivative — rate along one axis
the FTC bridge — derivative and integral

chapters.teaches: implicit field to explicit surface — marching cubes as the bridge from continuous to mesh
roles: the scalar field — a value at every point
the isovalue — the threshold is a surface
sculpt the field — add and subtract

chapters.teaches: CSG — union, intersection, difference as composition logic on solids
Newton — vectors become physics; force, mass, acceleration, friction, attraction
roles: the attractor — force toward a point

chapters.teaches: oscillation — force and energy exchange; sine creates curves; amplitude, frequency, phase
disorder as creative force — distributions, entropy, the seed
roles: distributions — not all randomness is flat

chapters.teaches: structured randomness — Perlin, octaves, flow fields
roles: the flow field — noise becomes direction

chapters.teaches: simple rules to complex behavior — Rule 110 is Turing complete, the edge of chaos
self-similarity, recursion, infinite detail
generative grammars — symbols rewritten into structure
emergence from constraint — WFC, Markov, adjacency
collective behavior — steering, the three boid rules, stigmergy
roles: one agent — a body with velocity

chapters.teaches: deformable matter — springs, cloth, damping, energy descent, morphogenesis
learning systems — the neuron, loss, gradient descent as a force downhill
connections define structure — the substrate under every map
roles: the graph under the maps — the substrate

chapters.teaches: the limits of formal systems — Russell, Gödel, Turing's halting problem
roles: prove it — or fail to, which is the point

chapters.teaches: the complete QFEP formula embodied — Question, Field, Entropy, Potential
practice after the crisis — bias, rhizomes, molecular design, the self-made archive
